Kaiya Chen: Hey everyone \u2014 Kaiya here, joining Platform Engineering today! Remote West Coast. Quick startup problems: I didn't receive access to the internal docker registry, and my VPN connection keeps dropping. Any tips? Also, who usually pairs on infra docs? :wave:
Alex (People Ops): Welcome Kaiya!! :tada: We'll get you sorted. Can you confirm your onboarding tracker link? I'll check the permissions.
Kaiya Chen: tracker link is https://redwood.internal/onboard/1758888888. Thanks Alex.
Mina (IT): Hi Kaiya \u2014 for the VPN drop, can you paste the client logs? On mac, try toggling 'Send all traffic over VPN' off then on in Settings > Network > VPN, and run `scutil --nc log` if it persists. For the docker registry, what's your docker login error?
Kaiya Chen: docker login gives "unauthorized: authentication required". VPN logs attached (screenshot).
Rory (ENG): Hey Kaiya \u2014 I'm the infra docs owner this quarter. Happy to pair. We also use the infra handbook in the repo `docs/infra` and hold office hours Thursdays. Ping me to schedule a walkthrough.
Mina (IT): I reset your VPN profile and pushed a cert update. Try reconnecting now.
OnboardBot: Onboarding status: Kaiya Chen added to groups 'platform-eng', 'infra-handbook'. Tasks: 2/7 complete.
Kaiya Chen: VPN reconnect worked, thanks Mina. Docker registry access still failing though.
Alex (People Ops): I escalated the registry ACL to the registry team and Rory. They should add your service account. Meanwhile use the public staging registry at registry.staging.redwood.ai for dev testing.
Rory (ENG): Added your username to the registry ACL, Kaiya. Try again and let me know.
Kaiya Chen: confirmed, docker login succeeded and I pulled the test image. Appreciate the quick help everyone! Looking forward to the walkthrough, Rory. :rocket:
